checks.rationale: The five local action blocks and nine material boundaries match the complete CITE-Seq row. Prepared antibodies and beads are incoming materials, not invented manufacturing operations. The RNA/surface-protein fork explains a cell, rather than splitting it into two preparations. Binding and encapsulation are genuinely joint operations; lysis and capture form one depicted local block. The DNA-generation block produces one mixed preparation from both template classes. Only the evidenced size-selection operation branches into two material fractions. Non-poly(A) RNA is retained in the lysate state without an invented fraction or waste route. The row contains no separate sequencing operation, and the final explanatory caption does not require inventing a data boundary.
